== Biography ==
'''Mary Glasgow''' was baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 23 Jun 1713. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-2475|John Glasgow]] and her mother as [[Kyle-2471|Isabell Kelle]].<ref name="FMP1" /> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Irvine is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

Mary Glasgow was one of the children recorded to John Glasgow and Isabell Kelle in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4112|Janet]] (1703), [[Glasgow-4119|Margaret]] (1708), [[Glasgow-4100|James]] (1711).
